$ kubectl explain svc.spec --recursive
--- exit 0
--- stdout
KIND:       Service
VERSION:    v1

FIELD: spec <ServiceSpec>

DESCRIPTION:
    Spec defines the behavior of a service.
    
FIELDS:
  type	<string>
  selector	<map[string]string>
  ports	<[]ServicePort>
    port	<integer>
    targetPort	<IntOrString>
    nodePort	<integer>
    name	<string>
    protocol	<string>
  clusterIP	<string>
--- stderr
